newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Jan inflation 6.4 pct - official.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Jan inflation 6.4 pct - official.

text.p: Ecuador's Consumer Price Index rose by 6.4 percent in January, up from 2.4 percent in the same month last year, the National Statistics and Census Institute said Friday.
Cumulative inflation for the past 12 months was 30.53 percent.
Inflation in Ecuador was 25.5 percent in 1996, up from 22.8 percent the year before.
In December, Ecuador's consumer prices rose 1.29 percent.
The government expects to close 1997 with an inflation rate of around 20 percent.
